title: A small adaptive gain carries a substantial planning bill
statement: The delivered synthetic workload has65536 independent Beta(2,2) primitives,21845 four-majority gates,one charged initial observation per source,1000 pairs fixed before their outcomes and19 evidence-selected local gate edits. It reports67536 total source draws,16152 online gate rebuilds and13.9003s build+5.2606s online/record time,197152KiB max RSS. Every selected fixed plan has reported regret<2.275e-14. Targets change, so initial/final risk differences or summed gains are not one fixed-target risk reduction. On the final learner state, adaptive gain[5.575310265482699e-7,5.575310267925343e-7] exceeds fixed[5.421230890395809e-7,5.421230892794569e-7] by>=1.540793726881298e-8,about2.84% of fixed two-call gain. Reconstruction11.3698s+query45.1596s and3276800 conditional groups are paid, with zero new physical draws. Ordinary incremental inference matches the capability. Delivered replay.json reports checks of all67536 bits/edits/enclosures, but the raw history transfer remains an uncertain candidate and is not used or replayed as verified source.

requires: Independent Beta(alpha_i,beta_i) priors with positive parameters and complete predictable direct Bernoulli source history. Adaptive source counts/stopping/target selection retain product posterior only under that direct-source likelihood.

Explicit read-once tree with disjoint primitive scopes and supplied2^k bounded[0,1] multiaffine gate tables. Target stays fixed over the contemplated future batch/two-step query; shared parameters, composite observations or source-law changes require a different likelihood/interface.

Arithmetic bounds count total nodes N,leaf count n,height h,actual arity k and explicit gate-table/derivative construction. Unary chains,deep trees,dense edits,exact bit growth and observation/maintenance data are paid.

assumptions: Completed producer working result with an actual acquired independent adaptive-two-step/finite-feature derivation and audit at its stated mathematical scope. Other fixed-review/resolution files named by the producer are not supplied and their reported findings do not become acquired review receipts. Thirteen current-turn files have event-verified delivery; complete_history.jsonl is an uncertain late-event candidate and is NOT imported as verified source, manifest unavailable, additional referenced unattached files not inferred. No retry/alternate transfer, science replay, new sign-off or historical-priority/practical-advantage claim. Independent declared Beta posteriors, stationary DIRECT source access and supplied DISJOINT-scope multiaffine trees are essential. Conditional Bayesian risk is not a uniform frequentist MSE guarantee; fixed-batch and exact adaptive TWO-step results are not general adaptive optimality. All equally informed ordinary incremental methods may use the same representation and match it.
costs: For fixed arity and budget B, source reports O(n 2^k B^k) arithmetic plus explicit gates/derivatives and O(nB) budget tables; at B2, O(N) construction/storage,O(h) real leaf/gate updates,O(Bh) plan recovery. This is not an O(h) update for the global adaptive first action.

Adaptive two-step query costs O(N+sum_i sum_(ancestors v)arity(v)), bounded by O(N+nkh), extra O(N) storage. Equally informed ordinary one-step compiler+hypothetical update/undo matches O(nh), with no new physical draws for hypothetical outcomes.

Synthetic depth8 workload uses65536 sources,21845 gates,65536 charged initial+2000 later observations,1000 fixed pairs and19 local target edits; build13.9003s,online5.2606s,16152 online gates,226128 candidate evaluations,258432 derivative entries. Changed targets prevent summing gains as one telescoping risk drop.

At the same final learner state, reconstruction costs11.3698s and adaptive query45.1596s for65536 first actions/3276800 conditional groups. Its gain is about2.84% above fixed-pair gain (not2.84% of total residual risk), with no new source calls; no total practical-efficiency win.

Reported complete replay JSON is delivered as a report, but uncertain raw history is not verified evidence or replayed by Capital. New PROOF/RUN files are distinct from the three earlier uncertain inference-frontier downloads.
